controls.Text: Changes take effect after OK. Terminal input only; browser/editor/native shortcuts are not configurable. Clipboard Copy/Paste keep fixed defaults. Unavailable actions are shown read-only.

options.error_or_status: Shortcut edits save after OK. Reset and Unbind in the edit dialog only change the draft.

capture.scope: production native subtree WM_DRAWITEM; may include cached owned WebView2 CapturePreview thumbnails; not a composed GPU or desktop capture

artifacts.scope: Production native client BUTTON/STATIC painters and live geometry on an owned offscreen DIB; EDIT content and nonclient titlebar pixels are absent; not a composed GPU or desktop screenshot
artifacts.name: keybindings-rows

deferred: Owned WM_IME_START/END messages exercise only application guards; they do not establish OS Korean IME/TSF correctness. The renderer hook is synthetic: physical keyboard/focus/IME and WebView/OS accelerator routing, per-monitor DPI, accessibility and composed visual acceptance are not established. PNG artifacts exclude EDIT content and nonclient titlebar pixels.
